pronunciation: uh · mee · lee · uh · RAY · shun
definition: An improvement that makes a bad situation less severe or harmful.
author: George Eliot
quote: “That is the rationale of the system of charging which has hitherto obtained; and nothing is more offensive than this ostentation of reform, where there is no real amelioration.”
example_sentence: The new heating brought some amelioration to the cold flat.
